rows.grounds: compound adjective describing Ganesha; internal members pratyūha, śānti, prada, ākhu, saṃstha
fused phrase with internal sandhi and spaces: dhyāyet hṛdabje satataṃ gaṇeśam

items.question: What form of Ganesha should one meditate upon in the heart-lotus for obstacle-peace?
items.inference: One should meditate on mouse-seated Ganesha in heart-lotus.
uncertainties: Token includes multiple words; sandhi not expanded.
items.plain_english: One should always meditate on Ganesha, seated on a mouse and granting peace from obstacles, in the lotus of the heart.
